# Release checklist

- [ ] Final derives from our own captured data or licensed data is clearly credited.
- [ ] Raw FITS, manifest, QA report, linear master, layered PSD, and recipe exist.
- [ ] 100% inspection shows no repeated texture, SXT holes, halos, clipped core,
      or over-shrunk stars.
- [ ] Background is neutral but not crushed; faint structure survives at calibrated brightness.
- [ ] Creator/copyright/contact and processing disclosure are in IPTC/XMP.
- [ ] Precise home GPS, address, serial number, Wi-Fi details, and personal data are absent.
- [ ] Content Credentials are attached or published when appropriate.
- [ ] Print master is 16-bit, unwatermarked, correctly sized, and soft-proofed.
- [ ] Web version is sRGB, sharpened only at final output size, and optionally watermarked.
- [ ] Filename contains target, capture date, integration, and processing version.
- [ ] Publication status was considered before any group-registration plan.
- [ ] Release filename, SHA-256, date, and destination URL are logged.
